top_signals.title: BofA’s Piron Says Won, Taiwan Dollar Offer Opportunity
top_signals.summary: BofA Global Research Head of Asia FX & Rates Strategy Claudio Piron sees opportunities to go long the Korean won and Taiwan dollar after the AI-driven selloff, arguing that strong current-account surpluses and continued export flows should provide support. He speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Putin seizes Japan Tobacco assets, further straining relations with Japan
top_signals.summary: The order impacts four manufacturing plants and has drawn immediate protest from Tokyo.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
